en.topic_title: Murder trial opens for ex-husband and in-laws of Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi
en.topic_summary:
A murder trial for the ex-husband and two former in-laws of Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi has opened, three and a half years after her killing and dismemberment shocked the city.



Hong Kong model and influencer Abby Choi, whose dismembered body was found by police in a Tai Po house on February 24, 2023. Photo: @xxabbyc/Instagram.



Alex Kwong, Choi’s ex-husband, his father Kwong Kau, and his brother Anthony Kwong stand accused of murdering Choi and preventing the lawful burial of a body
